name: AutoHotkey MCP
description: Run and manage AutoHotkey v2 scriptlets from your AI assistant: list, launch, stop, inspect source, and generate new scripts via sampling or local LLM. Connects to a script depot (autohotkey-tools) and, when running, the ScriptletCOMBridge on port 10764.
author: Sandra Schipal

tools.name: scriptlet_ops
tools.description: Scriptlet lifecycle management (portmanteau): list, run, stop, list_running, get_source, get_metadata, promote. 'run'/'stop'/'get_source'/'get_metadata'/'promote' require script_id. 'promote' moves a script from ai_generated/ into the live depot with persistence auto-fix, hotkey-collision check, and lint gate (force=True overrides non-persistence checks).

pid.description: Optional PID to target one instance on stop

force.description: Override hotkey-collision/lint gate on promote (persistence auto-fix always applies)

tools.name: ahk_dev_ops
tools.description: AI-assisted AHK authoring and help (portmanteau): generate, list_prompts, refine_prompt, help, show_help. 'generate' writes only to scriptlets/ai_generated/ after validation, using FastMCP sampling first with localhost HTTP fallback; no file is written on failure. 'help' levels: quick | reference | language | usage | tools | mcp_server.

rough.description: Vague idea to refine, required for refine_prompt

tools.name: macro_ops
tools.description: //trigger text-expansion macro management (portmanteau): list, get, upsert, delete. Macros are stored in sop/macros.md (single source of truth) and read by macro_expander.ahk in the depot. 'upsert' requires name (lowercase letters/digits/underscore) and template (use {1} {2} ... for positional params).

template.description: Template body with {1} {2} ... placeholders, required for upsert

tools.name: show_scriptlets_card
tools.description: Show all AutoHotkey scriptlets as a rich Prefab card: DataTable with running-status Dot, category Badge, search, and pagination. Uses the ScriptletCOMBridge when available, falls back to a depot scan.

tools.name: show_running_scriptlets_card
tools.description: Show currently running AutoHotkey scriptlets as a rich Prefab card: Dashboard KPIs plus a DataTable of live instances with hotkeys, description, and PID.

tools.name: show_ahk_help_card
tools.description: Show AutoHotkey v2 / autohotkey-mcp help as a rich Prefab card with Tabs per help level and Markdown content.

tools.name: show_scriptlet_detail_card
tools.description: Show a single AutoHotkey scriptlet as a rich Prefab card: source Code block, metadata Badges, and hotkey Kbd chips.

tools.name: show_generation_result_card
tools.description: Show a freshly generated scriptlet from ai_generated/ as a rich Prefab card, including a safety warning before promotion.

tools.name: show_server_status_card
tools.description: Show autohotkey-mcp server status as a rich Prefab card: Dashboard KPIs for bridge/exe status plus a config DataTable.
